proposals.expected_signal: Higher NDCG@10 if two-hop collaborative neighbors add useful signal beyond direct user-item edges while preserving LightGCN's low-parameter bias.
proposals.failure_mode: Performance drops if extra propagation over-smooths embeddings and collapses item discrimination for popular movies.
proposals.hypothesis: With unchanged full-sort evaluation, increasing propagation depth within a LightGCN-style model should improve rank quality when ML-1M signal is dominated by short collaborative paths that pairwise ranking can exploit.

proposals.expected_signal: Improved NDCG@10 if contrastive consistency across perturbed interaction graphs regularizes noisy user/item representations better than ranking loss alone.
proposals.failure_mode: Auxiliary loss can dominate sparse recommendation signal, producing invariant but weakly personalized embeddings and worse top-10 ranking.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a contrastive auxiliary objective to a message-transform graph should help when stochastic edge-drop views force stable user-item structure without changing the underlying candidate universe or sampler.

proposals.expected_signal: Detectable NDCG@10 gain if a simple latent-factor model benefits from more informative negative exposure while retaining the stable optimization behavior of uniform sampling.
proposals.failure_mode: No gain if the altered training emphasis only sharpens separation on easy negatives and leaves full-sort top-rank ordering unchanged.
proposals.hypothesis: Within a matrix-factorization backbone, changing the effective sampling emphasis toward harder observed-unobserved contrasts while keeping the formal sampler uniform can reveal whether current protocol is underfitting ranking margins rather than needing graph structure.

proposals.expected_signal: Higher NDCG@10 if lightweight feature transformation plus residual message passing captures asymmetric user-item interaction patterns missed by pure linear propagation.
proposals.failure_mode: Added transform capacity may overfit frequent users/items on ML-1M and underperform simpler propagators despite lower training loss.
proposals.hypothesis: A message-transform graph with residual per-layer transforms should outperform simpler propagation when limited nonlinear mixing improves how neighbor evidence is integrated before pairwise ranking.
